description: Keeps what matters from THIS conversation in the user's TabTree second brain: facts, decisions and lessons. Call it ONLY after you listed the items to the user in the conversation and they agreed — then once. Nothing is filed until the user accepts it in TabTree (a banner, on any of their devices). Use it when the user ends a conversation (thanks, "that's all", "ok bye") or right after a decision was made. Facts and decisions go to the "Company knowledge" map of ONE space (created if the space has none); lessons always go to the user's "🌱 Lessons" map in Personal. Never for tasks (use propose_changes or create_kanban). Never a password, key or token. If nothing is worth keeping, call it with nothing: true and tell the user so.

check_on.description: decision only: YYYY-MM-DD, the day to look at the signal.

detail.description: Optional: what a reader needs in six months. 1500 characters max.

kind.description: fact = what is true today (a price, an access, a client's answer); decision = what was decided, appended and never rewritten; lesson = what the user learned, reusable anywhere.

replaces.description: decision only: the EXACT text of an earlier decision this one supersedes. The earlier one is kept.

section.description: fact only, required: the section of the Company knowledge map — its EXACT name when it exists (read_map shows them; the defaults are "🔑 Access — who has what", "🌐 Domains & infrastructure", "🧰 Tools & subscriptions", "💼 Clients & deals", "📖 Playbooks", "⚖️ Decisions"), or a new name to create one.

signal.description: decision only: the observable sign that will say whether it was right, e.g. "Q4 margins back above 22%".

text.description: The entry's title: one sentence that stays true on its own, without the conversation. 300 characters max.

updates.description: fact only: the EXACT text of the entry of that section this fact replaces (its new value). Omit for a new entry.

why.description: One short line: why keep it. Shown next to the item when the user reviews it.

nothing.description: true when nothing is worth keeping — then send no items.

space.description: The space the conversation was about, by name (list_maps shows them). Omit for Personal. If two spaces could apply, ASK the user — never guess: facts never cross between spaces.

title.description: One line naming the conversation, e.g. "Discount request — Batimar". Shown in TabTree and written as the source of every entry.

name: harvest
